news.title: UNI hosts regional workshop exploring history's role in civic education

news.summary_en: A finance degree opens doors across nearly every industry. Discover the best double majors that can expand your career options and make your business education even more valuable.

news.title: UNI recognized for transfer student success nine years in a row
news.summary_en: For the ninth year in a row, the University of Northern Iowa has been recognized for its commitment to helping community college students seamlessly transfer and earn bachelor’s degrees. UNI once again made Phi Theta Kappa’s Transfer Honor Roll, a nationally known indicator of transfer excellence.

news.title: Business and Community Services makes an impact in all 99 Iowa counties
news.summary_en: Through its 12 outreach organizations, UNI's Business and Community Services (BCS) connects communities, businesses, nonprofits and public agencies with in-house industry leaders who help tackle complex problems. And the impact is vast.
